Orthodontics ranking-and-covariate excerpt

Source: R/paper_covariate_datasets.R
orthodontics_excerpt_2009.Rd

An anonymised, published excerpt from Tables 3 and 4 in Li, Yi and Liu (2022): 15 experts rank two non-overlapping groups (A and H) of 12 cases, with 11 PAR-index covariates for every case. The full 108-case clinical dataset is not provided by the article, so this deliberately exposes only the reproducible table excerpt.

Usage

orthodontics_excerpt_2009()

Value

A list with separate complete within-group ranking-position matrices, a 24-case covariate table, and source metadata. Lower values are better ranks in each ranking_positions matrix.

References

Li, X., Yi, D. and Liu, J. S. (2022). Bayesian analysis of rank data with covariates and heterogeneous rankers. Statistical Science, 37(1), 1–23. doi:10.1214/20-STS818
